home.lead: Meet your 24/7 AI assistant. Ask a question, get matched to the right service, and book an appointment — by text or voice, in your language. No hold music, ever.
home.f1p: Ask about services, hours, and pricing. Get instant, accurate answers from our knowledge base.
home.f2p: Prefer talking? Speak naturally and the AI responds with a human-like voice, in real time.
home.f3p: Book, reschedule, or cancel anytime. Confirmations land instantly by email and SMS.
home.f4p: Switch between English, Spanish, and French instantly — the whole site follows you.
home.f5p: Log in to see every upcoming appointment and manage your profile in one place.
home.f6p: Need a person? The AI escalates to a human the moment it can't help.
home.ctaP: Pick a service, choose a time, done. Your AI receptionist handles the rest.

about.p1: AZ AI Geeks builds conversion-focused websites and AI receptionists for local businesses. This portal is how your customers reach you — book a service, ask a question, or talk to the assistant, any hour of any day.
about.m1p: No customer should ever hit a voicemail and give up. We make every business instantly reachable.
about.m2p: AI first, humans always in reach. The assistant handles the routine so our team can handle the exceptions.
about.m3p: The AI only answers from a verified knowledge base. It never invents hours, prices, or promises.

svc.p: Not sure which one? Ask the AI assistant — bottom right — and it'll match you.

priv.intro: This demo stores your account and appointments locally in your browser only. In production, data is handled as described below.
priv.p1: Name, email, phone, and appointment details you provide to book and manage services.
priv.p2: To schedule appointments, send confirmations and reminders, and improve our service. We never sell your data.
priv.p3: Conversations may be processed by AI to answer questions and book appointments. The AI answers only from a verified knowledge base.
priv.p4: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting hello@azaigeeks.com.

terms.intro: By using this portal you agree to the following terms.
terms.p1: This portal lets you book and manage appointments. You agree to provide accurate information.
terms.p2: You may reschedule or cancel appointments through the portal or the AI assistant, subject to the business's cancellation window.
terms.p3: The AI provides information and booking help. For binding quotes or complex needs, a human team member will confirm.
terms.p4: This is provided as-is, without warranty, during the demonstration phase. Production terms will be provided at launch.
